Pick from existing users (sourced from the `users` table) or type a new Matrix ID like `@user:matrix.host`. POSTs to the realm-server through the Grafana datasource proxy, which adds the realm-server credential.

elements.tooltip: Pick from existing users or type a new Matrix user ID like @user:matrix.host

elements.title: Permission level
elements.tooltip: Read = read-only; Read/Write = read and write.

panels.title: Grant Permission

panels.description: Operator action: take a user's `read` or `read/write` access to this realm away. Pick from the users that hold a permission row on this realm (sourced from `realm_user_permissions`; the list leaves out the realm owner and the realm-wide `*` and `users` grants, which the endpoint refuses). POSTs to `/_grafana-remove-realm-user-permission` through the realm-server-operator datasource proxy. The removal deletes the user's permission row, takes the realm out of the user's workspace list, and refuses the user's existing realm sessions on the next request. The removal does not touch access the user holds through a `*` or `users` grant or a realm policy, and does not touch the user's Matrix account.

elements.title: Matrix username
elements.tooltip: Users that hold a permission row on this realm. The list leaves out the realm owner and the realm-wide `*` and `users` grants.

targets.rawSql: SELECT username FROM realm_user_permissions WHERE realm_url = ${realm_url:sqlstring} AND realm_owner = false AND username LIKE '@%:%' ORDER BY username;

panels.title: Remove Permission

panels.description: Permissions for this realm. To add or change a user's access, set the Matrix username and permission level in Grant Permission and click the Grant button. To take a user's access away, pick the user in Remove Permission and click the Remove button.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT 
  username,
  read,
  write,
  realm_owner,
  CASE
    WHEN realm_owner THEN 'owner'
    WHEN write THEN 'read/write'
    WHEN read THEN 'read'
    ELSE 'none'
  END AS permission
FROM realm_user_permissions
WHERE realm_url = ${realm_url:sqlstring}
ORDER BY realm_owner DESC, write DESC, read DESC, username ASC
LIMIT 500;

panels.title: Realm Permissions

panels.description: Each automation in the realm: the automation's payer and state now, and the runs the automation started and the credits the automation's charges drew in the time range. State reads "switched off" when an automation charged in the time range and someone has since switched the automation off. Credits charged adds up the run, run indexing, storage, AI and batched AI charges that name the automation or one of the automation's runs, whoever paid.

value.title: Open this user on the Users dashboard

targets.rawSql:
WITH charged AS (
  SELECT COALESCE(l.automation_id, r.automation_id) AS automation_id,
         MAX(l.realm) AS realm,
         -SUM(l.credit_amount) AS credits
    FROM credits_ledger l
    LEFT JOIN automation_runs r ON r.id = l.run_id
   WHERE l.realm IN (SELECT ${realm_url:sqlstring}
                  UNION
                  SELECT '@cardstack/' || substring(url from '([^/]+)/$') || '/' FROM realm_registry
                   WHERE url = ${realm_url:sqlstring} AND kind = 'bootstrap')
     AND (l.run_id IS NOT NULL OR l.automation_id IS NOT NULL)
     AND $__unixEpochFilter(l.created_at)
   GROUP BY 1
),
listed AS (
  SELECT automation_id FROM automations WHERE realm IN (SELECT ${realm_url:sqlstring}
                  UNION
                  SELECT '@cardstack/' || substring(url from '([^/]+)/$') || '/' FROM realm_registry
                   WHERE url = ${realm_url:sqlstring} AND kind = 'bootstrap')
  UNION
  SELECT automation_id FROM charged WHERE automation_id IS NOT NULL
),
ran AS (
  SELECT r.automation_id,
         COUNT(*) AS runs,
         COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE r.state = 'error') AS errors
    FROM automation_runs r
   WHERE r.realm IN (SELECT ${realm_url:sqlstring}
                  UNION
                  SELECT '@cardstack/' || substring(url from '([^/]+)/$') || '/' FROM realm_registry
                   WHERE url = ${realm_url:sqlstring} AND kind = 'bootstrap')
     AND $__timeFilter(r.created_at)
   GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT CASE WHEN starts_with(listed.automation_id, COALESCE(a.realm, c.realm)) THEN substr(listed.automation_id, length(COALESCE(a.realm, c.realm)) + 1) ELSE listed.automation_id END AS automation,
       listed.automation_id,
       a.payer,
       COALESCE(a.state, 'switched off') AS state,
       COALESCE(ran.runs, 0) AS runs,
       COALESCE(ran.errors, 0) AS errors,
       COALESCE(c.credits, 0) AS credits,
       a.pause_reason,
       a.next_run,
       a.last_finished_at,
       a.last_result,
       a.switched_on_at
  FROM listed
  LEFT JOIN automations a USING (automation_id)
  LEFT JOIN charged c USING (automation_id)
  LEFT JOIN ran USING (automation_id)
 ORDER BY (a.automation_id IS NOT NULL) DESC, credits DESC, automation
 LIMIT 500;

panels.title: Automations in this realm

panels.description: The credit ledger entries that name the realm in the time range, by charge kind and payer. Charges counts each charge once, however many credit buckets the charge drew on. Only consumption entries name a realm: run, run indexing, storage and batched AI entries always name the realm, and an AI entry names the realm when the AI request's caller named the realm.

value.title: Open this user on the Users dashboard

targets.rawSql:
SELECT l.charge_kind AS kind,
       u.matrix_user_id AS payer,
       COUNT(DISTINCT COALESCE(l.charge_id, l.id)) AS charges,
       COALESCE(-SUM(l.credit_amount) FILTER (WHERE l.credit_amount < 0), 0) AS charged,
       to_timestamp(MAX(l.created_at)) AS last_charged
  FROM credits_ledger l
  LEFT JOIN users u ON u.id = l.user_id
 WHERE l.realm IN (SELECT ${realm_url:sqlstring}
                  UNION
                  SELECT '@cardstack/' || substring(url from '([^/]+)/$') || '/' FROM realm_registry
                   WHERE url = ${realm_url:sqlstring} AND kind = 'bootstrap')
   AND $__unixEpochFilter(l.created_at)
 GROUP BY 1, 2
 ORDER BY charged DESC, kind, payer;

panels.title: Credits charged in this realm by charge kind

panels.description: Every charge that names the realm in the time range, newest first, with the payer. Credits charged shows the credits the charge drew from the payer's balance. Credit buckets shows how the charge split across the payer's plan allowance, daily credit and extra credit. The reference columns show what the charge paid for: the run's automation and trigger, the run, the AI batch, or the storage day. Usage priced lists the usage that the charge's pricing version priced: tab-seconds, worker-seconds, GB downloaded, GB-months, and the AI provider's cost and tokens.

value.title: Open this user on the Users dashboard

targets.rawSql:
WITH charges AS (
  SELECT COALESCE(l.charge_id, l.id) AS charge,
         MIN(l.created_at) AS created_at,
         l.charge_kind AS kind,
         l.user_id,
         l.realm,
         l.run_id,
         l.batch_id,
         l.automation_id,
         l.charge_day,
         l.pricing_version,
         COALESCE(-SUM(l.credit_amount) FILTER (WHERE l.credit_amount < 0), 0) AS charged,
         string_agg(l.credit_type::text || ' ' || abs(l.credit_amount), ', ' ORDER BY l.credit_type::text) AS buckets
    FROM credits_ledger l
   WHERE l.realm IN (SELECT ${realm_url:sqlstring}
                  UNION
                  SELECT '@cardstack/' || substring(url from '([^/]+)/$') || '/' FROM realm_registry
                   WHERE url = ${realm_url:sqlstring} AND kind = 'bootstrap')
     AND $__unixEpochFilter(l.created_at)
   GROUP BY 1, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7, 8, 9, 10
)
SELECT to_timestamp(c.created_at) AS time,
       c.kind,
       u.matrix_user_id AS payer,
       c.charged,
       c.buckets,
       CASE WHEN starts_with(COALESCE(c.automation_id, r.automation_id), c.realm) THEN substr(COALESCE(c.automation_id, r.automation_id), length(c.realm) + 1) ELSE COALESCE(c.automation_id, r.automation_id) END AS automation,
       r.trigger,
       (SELECT string_agg(g.unit || ' ' || trim_scale(round(g.quantity, 6))::text, ', ' ORDER BY g.unit)
          FROM credit_charge_usage g
         WHERE g.charge_id = c.charge) AS usage,
       c.run_id,
       c.batch_id,
       c.charge_day::text AS charge_day,
       c.pricing_version
  FROM charges c
  LEFT JOIN automation_runs r ON r.id = c.run_id
  LEFT JOIN users u ON u.id = c.user_id
 ORDER BY c.created_at DESC
 LIMIT 500;

panels.title: Credit ledger for this realm

panels.description: Indexing job status for this realm. Pending and in-flight counts come from the jobs/job_reservations tables, scoped to from-scratch-index and incremental-index for this realm. full-reindex is system-wide and not shown here.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE j.status = 'unfulfilled' AND jr.id IS NULL) AS pending,
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE j.status = 'unfulfilled' AND jr.id IS NOT NULL) AS in_flight,
  MAX(j.finished_at) AS last_completed_at,
  EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (NOW() - MIN(j.created_at) FILTER (WHERE j.status = 'unfulfilled' AND jr.id IS NULL))) AS oldest_pending_seconds
 FROM jobs j
 LEFT JOIN job_reservations jr ON j.id = jr.job_id
   AND jr.completed_at IS NULL AND jr.locked_until > NOW()
 WHERE j.job_type IN ('from-scratch-index','incremental-index')
   AND COALESCE(j.args->>'realmURL','') = ${realm_url:sqlstring};

panels.title: Indexing status (this realm)

panels.description: Operator action: queue a from-scratch reindex for the realm currently selected in the **Realm** picker (template variable `${realm_url}`). Live blast-radius (pending / in-flight / oldest pending) is fetched every refresh; the button disables itself while an indexing job is already in flight. Click POSTs to `/_grafana-reindex?realm=...` through the Grafana datasource proxy, which adds the realm-server credential. System-wide "Reindex ALL realms" lives on the Indexing dashboard.

elements.title: Pending jobs
elements.tooltip: Indexing jobs queued for this realm with no live worker reservation.

elements.title: In-flight
elements.tooltip: Indexing jobs currently held by a worker for this realm. While > 0, the reindex button is disabled.

elements.title: Oldest pending
elements.tooltip: Age of the oldest pending indexing job for this realm. Sustained age usually means workers are saturated or stuck.

elements.title: Last reindex
elements.tooltip: Most recent from-scratch-index for this realm. Reads from the jobs / job_progress tables (CS-10930).
POST /_grafana-reindex?realm=${realm_url}. Disabled while an indexing job is in flight for this realm.

targets.rawSql:
WITH realm_jobs AS (
  SELECT j.*
    FROM jobs j
   WHERE j.job_type IN ('from-scratch-index','incremental-index')
     AND COALESCE(j.args->>'realmURL','') = '${realm_url}'
),
realm_pending AS (
  SELECT COUNT(*) AS n,
         MIN(j.created_at) AS oldest_created
    FROM realm_jobs j
    LEFT JOIN job_reservations jr ON j.id = jr.job_id
      AND jr.completed_at IS NULL AND jr.locked_until > NOW()
   WHERE j.status = 'unfulfilled' AND jr.id IS NULL
),
realm_in_flight AS (
  SELECT COUNT(*) AS n
    FROM realm_jobs j
    JOIN job_reservations jr ON j.id = jr.job_id
      AND jr.completed_at IS NULL AND jr.locked_until > NOW()
   WHERE j.finished_at IS NULL
),
last_reindex AS (
  SELECT j.id, j.created_at AS started, j.finished_at AS finished,
         j.status,
         COALESCE(jp.files_completed, 0) AS files_completed,
         COALESCE(jp.total_files, 0) AS total_files
    FROM realm_jobs j
    LEFT JOIN job_progress jp ON jp.job_id = j.id
   WHERE j.job_type = 'from-scratch-index'
   ORDER BY j.created_at DESC
   LIMIT 1
)
SELECT
  '${realm_url}' AS realm,
  COALESCE((SELECT n FROM realm_pending), 0) AS pending,
  COALESCE((SELECT n FROM realm_in_flight), 0) AS in_flight,
  CASE
    WHEN (SELECT oldest_created FROM realm_pending) IS NULL THEN '—'
    ELSE TO_CHAR(NOW() - (SELECT oldest_created FROM realm_pending), 'HH24:MI:SS')
      || ' (since ' || TO_CHAR((SELECT oldest_created FROM realm_pending) AT TIME ZONE 'UTC', 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') || ' UTC)'
  END AS oldest_pending_human,
  COALESCE(
    (SELECT
       CASE
         WHEN finished IS NULL AND started IS NOT NULL THEN
           'running — ' || files_completed || '/' || NULLIF(total_files,0) || ' files, started ' || TO_CHAR(started AT TIME ZONE 'UTC', 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') || ' UTC'
         WHEN finished IS NOT NULL THEN
           INITCAP(COALESCE(status::text,'finished')) || ' at ' || TO_CHAR(finished AT TIME ZONE 'UTC', 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') || ' UTC'
         ELSE COALESCE(status::text,'unknown')
       END
     FROM last_reindex),
    'never'
  ) AS last_reindex_status;

panels.description: Operator action: add the realm selected in the **Realm** picker (template variable `${realm_url}`) to the Catalogs section of every signed-in user's dashboard, or take it out. Only public realms (a `*` read grant) can be catalogs; every other public realm stays reachable by URL without being listed. The choice persists in `realm_metadata.show_as_catalog`. Clicks POST to `/_grafana-set-realm-catalog?realm=...&catalog=true|false` through the Grafana datasource proxy, which adds the realm-server credential. Other realm-server instances serve the change within a minute.

elements.title: Public
elements.tooltip: Whether the realm has a `*` read grant. Only public realms can be catalogs.

elements.title: In Catalogs
elements.tooltip: Whether realm_metadata.show_as_catalog is set, which lists the realm in every signed-in user's Catalogs section.
POST /_grafana-set-realm-catalog?realm=${realm_url}&catalog=true. Disabled unless the realm is public and not already in Catalogs.
POST /_grafana-set-realm-catalog?realm=${realm_url}&catalog=false. Disabled unless the realm is in Catalogs.

panels.description: Files in this realm whose latest index attempt errored. Click a row to open Logs filtered to this realm.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  url,
  error_doc->>'message' AS error_message,
  to_timestamp(indexed_at / 1000.0) AS indexed_at
FROM boxel_index
WHERE realm_url = ${realm_url:sqlstring}
  AND type = 'error'
  AND is_deleted IS NOT TRUE
ORDER BY indexed_at DESC
LIMIT 200;

panels.title: Recent Indexing Errors

panels.description: Most recent index jobs for this realm whose `finished_at` is set. Joined to the latest `job_reservations` row to derive a started_at and the worker-scoped job id `J.R`. Click a row to open Boxel Logs filtered to that job (Indexing Job Activity panel). full-reindex jobs aren’t realm-scoped (no `args.realmURL`) and don’t appear here — they’re visible on the Indexing dashboard.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  j.id::text || '.' || COALESCE(jr.id::text, '-') AS job_id,
  j.id::text AS job_id_short,
  j.job_type,
  j.status::text AS status,
  COALESCE(jr.created_at, j.created_at) AS started_at,
  j.finished_at,
  (EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM COALESCE(jr.created_at, j.created_at)) * 1000)::bigint - 300000 AS log_window_from_ms,
  (EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM j.finished_at) * 1000)::bigint + 300000 AS log_window_to_ms,
  EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (j.finished_at - COALESCE(jr.created_at, j.created_at))) AS duration_seconds,
  COALESCE(jp.files_completed, 0) AS files_completed,
  COALESCE(jp.total_files, 0) AS total_files
FROM jobs j
LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
  SELECT * FROM job_reservations jr2
   WHERE jr2.job_id = j.id
   ORDER BY jr2.created_at DESC
   LIMIT 1
) jr ON TRUE
LEFT JOIN job_progress jp ON jp.job_id = j.id
WHERE j.job_type IN ('from-scratch-index','incremental-index')
  AND j.finished_at IS NOT NULL
  AND COALESCE(j.args->>'realmURL', '') = ${realm_url:sqlstring}
ORDER BY j.finished_at DESC
LIMIT 100;
